scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.docker:build: neon-env run -- docker build -t ticktask --build-arg NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL --build-arg NEON_REALTIME_URL .
scripts.docker:start: neon-env run -- docker run --rm -d --name ticktask -p 3000:3000 -e NODE_ENV=production -e BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:3000 -e FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000 -e DATABASE_URL -e DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED -e NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL -e NEON_AUTH_JWKS_URL -e NEON_REALTIME_URL -e NEON_REALTIME_SECRET ticktask
